title: Asset Metadata (v1)
description: Schema for asset.json, stored alongside content.<ext> at library/assets/sha256/<aa>/<hash>/asset.json (the content-addressed layout internal/profile.canonicalAssetPath and internal/manifest.assetPath both resolve against). No Go struct defines this file's contents yet — the Go tooling only reads/writes the sibling content.<ext> file by path and verifies its SHA-256 against a profile's AssetSelection (see canonical-profile.schema.json) — so this schema is forward-looking and documents the intended asset-metadata shape. retentionState reuses the same RetentionOutcome vocabulary as policy.schema.json's PolicyRule.mode; a tracked-external, promote-on-approval, or quarantined asset record may describe content that is not (yet, or ever) materialized locally, so contentFile/byteSize/dimensions are only required once retentionState is "managed".

sha256.description: Exact-byte SHA-256 of the asset's content. When retentionState is "managed" this must equal the <hash> directory segment and the hash of the sibling content.<ext> file.

contentFile.description: Filename of the sibling content file, e.g. "content.png". Only meaningful (and required) when retentionState is "managed", since that is the only state guaranteeing local exact-byte content exists.

mediaType.description: IANA media type of the content, e.g. image/png, image/jpeg, video/webm.

retentionState.description: Outcome of retention policy evaluation for this asset (see policy.schema.json). "managed" assets have local exact-byte content under this directory; "tracked-external", "promote-on-approval", and "quarantined" assets may be metadata-only records describing content that lives elsewhere, awaits approval, or has been set aside, respectively. Presentation/profile selection alone never silently changes this state to "managed".

dimensions.description: Optional pixel dimensions for image/video assets.

sourceRef.description: Optional id of the source (see source.schema.json) this asset was retrieved from.

variants.description: Related asset content addresses derived from this asset (e.g. a downscaled thumbnail), each a full AssetRef so role is explicit.
